quarterly_data.quarter: Crusoe press release: Polar & Crusoe expand Norway AI partnership to 40MW (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Polar Data Centers' DRA01 facility in Tordal, Norway is now live, providing 12MW of IT capacity powered by 100% hydroelectric energy and supporting Crusoe Cloud; the partnership expands into DRA02, the next phase of the Tordal campus, expected to go live in late 2027 with an additional 40MW of liquid-cooled IT capacity, where Crusoe plans to deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72.
